name: Unidentified droid captain
description: During the Clone Wars, a B1 battle droid captain commanded the Separatist leader Count Dooku's personal Munificent-class star frigate. Circa 21 BBY, while inside an ice field, the frigate came across the damaged Delta-7B Jedi starfighter of Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker. The droid Captain ordered the fighter and its pilot to be captured, and Skywalker was subsequently apprehended. However, the Jedi had planned his capture and disabled the security systems of the frigate, which allowed Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi to infiltrate the ship unseen. As the Jedi confronted Dooku together, the frigate was ambushed by the Republic Venator-class Star Destroyer Resolute. Pursued by the Jedi pair, Dooku was able to escape from the frigate, and the Captain was left to take care of the destroyer.
